BrochureContent.Content:
This superb 3 bed terrace property is nestled in the cul-de-sac adjacent to the former garden walls of Horetown House. The property is presented to the market in excellent condition and ready to welcome new owners. 

The accommodation briefly features entrance hallway, sitting room, kitchen/dining area, a utility room and a guest w.c. Upstairs there are three bedrooms, including a master with ensuite and a family bathroom.

The Coachman's Yard offers a retreat like environment, nestled within the countryside of South County Wexford, ensuring a tranquil rural setting within convenient reach of the coastline and Wexford town.

The area has a number of very good schools, sports clubs and community groups. 

Virtual tour online. 

Viewing by appointment with Auctioneer Joe Bishop 087 2744518.
